alembic-migrations-with-generated-tsvect: alembic migrations with generated tsvector columns: inline the to_tsvector(...) expression as a string constant DIRECTLY in the migration file. Do NOT import a shared constant from ORM models. Migrations must be frozen snapshots — if a shared constant changes later, fresh DBs get the new expression while already-migrated DBs keep the old, silently diverging. Keep the ORM constant separate for model use.
alembic-revision-strings-must-be-32-char: alembic revision strings must be 32 chars or less — alembic_version.version_num is VARCHAR(32). Symptom: StringDataRightTruncationError on alembic upgrade. Fix: shorten the revision string in the migration file (filename can differ). Confirmed in convfinqa-f7f.92.
asyncpg-pytest-asyncio-cannot-perform-op: asyncpg + pytest-asyncio: 'cannot perform operation: another operation is in progress' on second test means a session-scoped async fixture is bound to a different event loop than the per-test loop. Fix: set asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope=session in pyproject [tool.pytest.ini_options] AND pass loop_scope='session' on every @pytest_asyncio.fixture AND use poolclass=NullPool on test engines. Verified in convfinqa slice 1.
asyncpg-raw-sql-pattern-use-cast-param-a: asyncpg raw SQL pattern: use CAST(:param AS uuid) not :param::uuid — the :: cast syntax conflicts with asyncpg's SQLAlchemy parameter rendering and causes ProgrammingError. Always CAST when passing UUID strings in text() queries.
aws-provider-v6-data-aws-region-current-: AWS provider v6: data.aws_region.current.name is deprecated — use .id instead for the region string (e.g. eu-west-2)
bedrock-claude-haiku-4-5-from-london-eu: Bedrock Claude Haiku 4.5 from London (eu-west-2): not in-region (only eu-north-1, eu-west-1 host directly), but eu-west-2 IS a valid SOURCE for the EU cross-region inference profile bedrock/eu.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0. The 'global.' profile also accepts eu-west-2. Source: AWS Haiku 4.5 model card + inference-profile support matrix. Don't 'correct' eu-west-2 to eu-west-1 — both work, eu-west-2 keeps boto3 calls in London while CRIS routes the inference.
biome-2-x-in-convfinqa-frontend-set-up: Biome 2.x in convfinqa frontend (set up 2026-05-11 in 0hu.8): config at frontend/biome.json, lefthook.yml at REPO ROOT (not in frontend/ — lefthook walks to git root for discovery; frontend-scoping via glob:'frontend/**' + root:'frontend/'). Indent: tab + double quotes for TS/TSX (matches Vite scaffold), JSON gets space/2. CSS parser MUST have tailwindDirectives:true so globals.css with @custom-variant/@theme/@utility parses. Override 'useComponentExportOnlyModules: off' for src/routes/** + src/components/ui/** (Biome's react-refresh equivalent — same scope as the prior eslint config). Replaced eslint scripts with format/lint/check/ci/typecheck. 'biome ci' = read-only CI variant, 'biome check --write' = local autofix all-in-one.
biome-a11y-rule-useariapropssupportedbyr: Biome a11y rule useAriaPropsSupportedByRole false-positives on <aside role={x?'dialog':undefined} aria-modal={x?true:undefined}> because static analysis can't pair the conditional attrs. Workaround used in this repo: build the dialog attrs in an object (typed as Record<string, unknown>) and spread it onto the JSX element — Biome can't introspect spread keys. Pattern at frontend/src/routes/_authed.tsx + frontend/src/components/RightPanel.tsx.
cognito-access-tokens-no-aud-claim-use-c: Cognito access tokens: no 'aud' claim, use 'client_id' claim instead. email field absent by default (only in ID tokens). Always validate token_use=='access' to reject ID tokens. Adapter in adapters/auth/cognito_jwks.py uses injectable fetch_jwks callable for testability.
convfinqa-aws-stack-design-may-2026-ecs-: convfinqa AWS stack design (May 2026): ECS Express Mode (Fargate + auto-wired ALB) for FastAPI streaming backend ~$28/mo. Aurora Serverless v2 Postgres min 0 ACU with keep-alive Lambda + SQLAlchemy pool tuning + frontend warmup loader. S3 + CloudFront OAC for SPA mirroring francescoalbanese-dev-infra pattern. Five TypeScript Lambdas (login/callback/refresh/logout/post-confirmation) for Cognito-with-Google auth setting HTTPOnly + Secure + SameSite=Lax cookies. Single CloudFront domain app.convfinqa.francescoalbanese.dev with three behaviors: /api/v1/* → ALB, /api/auth/* → Lambda BFF, /* → S3. SSM Parameter Store SecureString for secrets. Postgres tables (not DynamoDB or Redis) for cache/rate-limit/idempotency via pg_cron TTL. Cognito sub mapped to users.cognito_sub UNIQUE in Postgres; row created by Post-Confirmation Lambda Trigger with defensive UPSERT in BFF callback as fallback. DNS records owned by convfinqa terraform via cross-account aws.shared_services provider into the parent francescoalbanese.dev zone in shared-services account. Single Terraform stack split into network/data/edge/compute/keepalive modules so terraform destroy -target=module.compute drops cost to ~$2/mo. One GitHub Actions workflow with path-filtered jobs; migrations as one-shot ECS RunTask before backend-deploy. Full rationale, runtime flows, disqualified alternatives, and operational runbook in docs/aws-architecture.html. Rule pointer at .claude/rules/infrastructure/aws-architecture.md.
convfinqa-postgres-image-pin-rationale-d: convfinqa Postgres image pin rationale: docker-compose.yml uses postgres:18.3-bookworm. Don't change to: latest (moves with releases), bare 18.3 (default Debian base may flip), trixie (Debian 13, less mileage with asyncpg), alpine (musl, occasional asyncpg/locale edge cases). Bookworm = Debian 12, what testcontainers + most CI stacks use.
convfinqa-settings-singleton-anti-patter: convfinqa SETTINGS singleton anti-pattern: src/convfinqa/config.py:SETTINGS exists ONLY for the lifespan to bootstrap the container once. Inside route handlers, use cases, and adapters NEVER import SETTINGS — inject Settings via container/DI dependency (entrypoints/api/dependencies.py:SettingsDep). Reading SETTINGS directly defeats Container.for_testing(settings=...) overrides and breaks tests with custom configs. Caught in slice 1 quality gate.
convfinqa-streaming-disconnect-test-patt: convfinqa streaming disconnect test pattern: httpx ASGITransport CANNOT mid-stream-disconnect (it runs the ASGI app to completion regardless of client.stream context exit). Solution: test the GeneratorExit handler at the use-case layer with await events.aclose(). This is sound because Starlette's StreamingResponse cancels by calling aclose() on the body iterator on real client disconnect — same code path. Don't try to make ASGITransport do mid-stream disconnect; spin up a real server only if you need end-to-end network behaviour.
convfinqa-timestamp-single-source-of-tru: convfinqa timestamp single-source-of-truth: when a use case persists a row with a created_at and the presenter needs that same timestamp in its response, the use case MUST surface it (e.g. via the Finish event). Calling datetime.now(UTC) in both the use case AND the presenter produces millisecond drift between the DB row and the HTTP body — flaky tests + inconsistent client UX. Caught in slice 1 quality gate.
files-matching-env-including-env-example: Files matching '.env' (including .env.example, .env.local, etc.) are blocked from Read AND Bash cat by ~/.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh and block-cat-sensitive.sh. Workarounds: 1) read committed content via 'git show HEAD:.env.example'; 2) ask the user to apply changes manually and surface the diff. Edit/Write tools also fail because they require Read first. Don't try to bypass — surface to the user.
frontend-markdown-renderer: Use Vercel `streamdown` for ALL assistant-message markdown rendering. NEVER `react-markdown` + `remark-gfm`. Streamdown is API-compatible with react-markdown's components prop but handles unterminated chunks during SSE streaming (no flicker on half-closed code fences/tables/bold), ships GFM by default, has prompt-injection hardening, and is from the same vendor as @ai-sdk/react which we depend on. Required CSS wiring in frontend/src/styles/globals.css: `@import "streamdown/styles.css";` and `@source "../../node_modules/streamdown/dist/*.js";`. For plain text bubbles use `controls={false}` to suppress code/table copy buttons until a ticket asks for them. See .claude/rules/frontend/markdown-streaming.md. Decision made in convfinqa-lzf after rb3.6 originally specced react-markdown.
frontend-package-manager-always-pnpm-nev: FRONTEND PACKAGE MANAGER: ALWAYS pnpm, NEVER bun/npm/yarn. Pinned by /Users/francescoalbanese/Documents/Development/convfinqa/.claude/rules/frontend/package-manager.md. Supply-chain: minimumReleaseAge=10080 + blockExoticSubdeps=true in pnpm-workspace.yaml (or .npmrc equivalent). CI uses pnpm/action-setup@v4. The convfinqa-0hu epic was wrongly scaffolded with Bun on 2026-05-10; remediation tracked under convfinqa-0hu.9 (blocks all sibling .2-.8). Before adding any frontend dep or scaffolding ANY JS workspace, re-read this rule.
frontend-vitest-fake-timers-radix-dialog: Vitest fake timers (vi.useFakeTimers) break Radix Dialog + TanStack Query tests: rAF gets mocked too, so Radix focus traps and React 19 scheduling stall and tests time out at the default 5s. For debounce tests rendered inside a Dialog: use REAL timers + waitFor with a generous timeout (1000ms) to assert the debounced fetch URL. If you truly need fake timers for non-Radix surfaces, scope them via vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['setTimeout','clearTimeout'] }) to leave rAF alone. Hit during convfinqa-dj6.6 (DocPicker).
health-endpoints-backend-exposes-healthz: Health endpoints: backend exposes /healthz and /readyz at root (k8s liveness/readiness convention, unversioned). /v1/* is reserved for app endpoints like chat. Frontend dev proxy (vite.config.ts) proxies /v1, /healthz, /readyz. PRD 0hu.4 criterion 2 originally said fetch('/v1/healthz'); amended 2026-05-11 (via convfinqa-0hu.11) to fetch('/healthz') because adding a versioned alias purely to satisfy a literal criterion is busywork and would muddle the convention. Do NOT add /v1/healthz to backend.
lefthook-beads-coexistence-convfinqa-est: Lefthook + beads coexistence (convfinqa, established 2026-05-11): beads owns core.hooksPath=.beads/hooks/. 'lefthook install' would conflict (--force overwrites bd shim, --reset-hooks-path unsets core.hooksPath). Solution: chain lefthook into .beads/hooks/pre-commit AFTER the BEADS INTEGRATION markers (file IS git-tracked, markers say external content preserved). frontend/scripts/install-hooks.sh re-applies idempotently via 'BEGIN LEFTHOOK CHAIN (frontend)' marker; wired as 'prepare' in frontend/package.json. Same approach applies if prek is ever activated for the backend.
lefthook-pre-commit-must-chain-vite-buil: lefthook pre-commit MUST chain vite build → pnpm test as one piped command, NOT run them as parallel siblings. @tanstack/router-plugin regenerates frontend/src/routeTree.gen.ts during every vite build, and vitest reading that file mid-write produces flaky empty <div/> renders in authedShell.test.tsx and app.test.tsx (router fails to register routes). Fixed in 2026-05-12 by collapsing build+test into a single 'build-and-test' command running 'pnpm exec vite build && pnpm test'. Rule documented in .claude/rules/frontend/quality-gates.md. Caught by convfinqa-1v3.
node-25-s-globalthis-localstorage-is-an-: Node 25's globalThis.localStorage is an empty null-prototype stub (no setItem/clear/getItem etc) unless --localstorage-file is set. Vitest's populateGlobal skips it because it's not in its KEYS list, so jsdom's working Storage never reaches window.localStorage. Frontend tests need a manual in-memory Storage shim installed via Object.defineProperty in src/test/setup.ts. Rule documented at .claude/rules/frontend/test-localstorage.md.
playwright-addinitscript-fires-on-every-: Playwright addInitScript fires on EVERY navigation including reload. Tests that simulate a localStorage change followed by reload need a NEW addInitScript call after the change (last-write-wins among addInitScripts) — page.evaluate alone is wiped on reload by any prior addInitScript that re-seeds the same key. Pattern used in convfinqa frontend/tests/e2e/steps/theme.steps.ts (uf5.4).
playwright-streaming-sse-mock-pattern-ro: Playwright streaming SSE mock pattern: route.fulfill cannot stream chunked SSE bodies (body is buffered). To exercise mid-stream cancellation (Stop button, AbortSignal) in playwright-bdd, monkey-patch globalThis.fetch via page.addInitScript and return a Response wrapping a ReadableStream you control. Attach init?.signal abort listener to close the stream so useChat.stop() halts the mock. Tag-scope the install with { tags: '@your-tag' } so unrelated features aren't shadowed. Canonical example: frontend/tests/e2e/steps/stop-and-recover.steps.ts (convfinqa-bmu.4).
postgres-partial-index-predicates-must-u: Postgres partial index predicates must use IMMUTABLE functions only. now() and current_timestamp are STABLE, so WHERE expires_at > now() is invalid as a partial index predicate. Use a plain B-tree index on expires_at instead; the query WHERE clause handles the filter correctly at runtime.
pytest-marker-auto-tag-pattern-extract-t: Pytest marker auto-tag pattern: extract the path→marker policy (PATH_MARKERS dict + apply/unmarked helpers) into tests/marker_policy.py rather than inlining in conftest. The conftest hook calls the helpers, AND the pytester behaviour test imports them and runs the real logic via runpytest() (in-process). Avoids duplicating the policy in a synthetic conftest. Use explicit branching (pytest.mark.unit if name == 'unit' else pytest.mark.integration), not getattr(pytest.mark, name) — the latter trips pyright strict reportUnknownMemberType.
shadcn-cli-v4-7-monorepo-gate-resolved-2: shadcn CLI v4.7 monorepo gate (resolved 2026-05-11 in convfinqa-0hu.10): frontend/pnpm-workspace.yaml MUST NOT contain a 'packages:' key under the current single-package layout. Keep only 'minimumReleaseAge: 10080' + 'blockExoticSubdeps: true'. With that, 'pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add <component>' works directly with no workaround. Re-add 'packages:' only if a true multi-package frontend workspace is introduced (e.g. apps/web + packages/ui); then invoke shadcn with '-c <subdir>'. Rule lives in .claude/rules/frontend/package-manager.md.
sidebar-virtualization-is-deferred-to-co: Sidebar virtualization is deferred to convfinqa-fxn.4. gbl.2 ships Sidebar.tsx without @tanstack/react-virtual; the API contract is locked at SidebarChatGroup[] (id, documentId, documentTitle, chats[]) so fxn.4 can swap in the virtualizer without prop changes. Reason: AC for gbl.2 does not mention virtualization, fxn.4 explicitly owns 'grouped chat list + filter + Virtual', virtualizing [] is dead infra.
sqlalchemy-text-with-postgresql-type-cas: SQLAlchemy text() with PostgreSQL '::type' cast syntax (e.g. ':year_min::int') breaks parameter substitution under asyncpg — SQLAlchemy keeps the first :name unsubstituted (sees the trailing :: as part of the name) but substitutes subsequent occurrences, producing 'syntax error at or near :' from postgres. Fix: use CAST(:param AS type) instead. Hit on 2026-05-12 in convfinqa-dj6.2 documents_repo.py.
tabletorowmajor-js-integer-key-reorder: JS Object.keys + JSON.parse REORDER integer-like string keys: keys parseable as 32-bit unsigned int (e.g. '2007','2008') iterate FIRST in ascending numeric order, then non-integer keys in insertion order. The JKHY 2009 cash-flow doc table has columns 'Year ended June 30, 2009','2008','2007' on the wire; after JSON.parse they iterate as '2007','2008','Year ended June 30, 2009' — backwards for display. lib/transforms/tableToRowMajor.ts faithfully preserves whatever JS hands it (AC = 'preserves input dict insertion order'), but the wire order is lost upstream at JSON.parse. Follow-up: convfinqa-tha. Will bite convfinqa-9ye.2 (DocTable) when it first renders real data.
ttlcache-k-v-in-strict-pyright-cachetool: TTLCache[K, V] in strict pyright: cachetools TTLCache is invariant, so field declarations and __post_init__ assignments need # pyright: ignore[reportUnknownVariableType,reportAssignmentType,reportAttributeAccessIssue]. Keep ignores narrow, one code each.
usemodaldialog-hook-at-frontend-src-lib-: useModalDialog hook at frontend/src/lib/ui/useModalDialog.ts provides reusable modal a11y package (role=dialog/aria-modal toggled at usage site via spread to bypass Biome's useAriaPropsSupportedByRole false-positive on conditional aria-modal; Tab trap; Escape-to-close at container scope so Radix Dialog Esc still wins for nested portals; initial focus via data-modal-initial-focus opt-in with first-focusable fallback; restore focus to document.activeElement captured at open). Pair with useIsBelowLg() for the 1024px breakpoint trigger. The advisor's three concrete gotchas (jsdom offsetParent=null, lg:inline-flex hidden first focusable on mobile, container-scoped Esc to avoid stomping Radix) are baked into the hook.
user-event-v14-click-on-radix-dropdownme: user-event v14 click on Radix DropdownMenuRadioItem nested in a SubContent portal does NOT trigger onSelect/onValueChange under jsdom. Likely because the SubContent renders in a Portal and Radix uses pointer events the test runner doesn't dispatch through the portal correctly. PointerEventsCheckLevel.Never does not help. Fix: focus the radio element and use user.keyboard('{Enter}'). Both fireEvent.click(radio) and Enter work; keyboard is preferred (keeps test in user-event API, matches a11y flow). Pattern: radio.focus(); await user.keyboard('{Enter}'). Discovered in convfinqa-uf5.3 UserMenu theme submenu tests.
